original_prompt: Generate an Ansible playbook that installs and configures the Prometheus node_exporter (binary install, systemd service) on a Linux host listening on port 9100.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Generate an Ansible playbook that installs and configures the Prometheus node_exporter (binary install, systemd service) on a Linux host listening on port 9100.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Install and configure Prometheus node_exporter
  hosts: all
  become: yes
  vars:
    node_exporter_version: "1.7.0"
    node_exporter_binary_url: "https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter/releases/download/v{{ node_exporter_version }}/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.linux-amd64.tar.gz"
    node_exporter_install_dir: "/opt/node_exporter"
    node_exporter_user: "node_exporter"
    node_exporter_group: "node_exporter"
    node_exporter_port: 9100
    node_exporter_listen_address: "0.0.0.0:{{ node_exporter_port }}"

  tasks:
    - name: Create node_exporter group
      group:
        name: "{{ node_exporter_group }}"
        state: present
        system: yes

    - name: Create node_exporter user
      user:
        name: "{{ node_exporter_user }}"
        group: "{{ node_exporter_group }}"
        system: yes
        shell: "/usr/sbin/nologin"
        home: "{{ node_exporter_install_dir }}"
        create_home: no
        state: present

    - name: Create installation directory
      file:
        path: "{{ node_exporter_install_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ node_exporter_user }}"
        group: "{{ node_exporter_group }}"
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Download node_exporter binary
      get_url:
        url: "{{ node_exporter_binary_url }}"
        dest: "/tmp/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.tar.gz"
        mode: '0644'
        checksum: "sha256:https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter/releases/download/v{{ node_exporter_version }}/sha256sums.txt"

    - name: Extract node_exporter binary
      unarchive:
        src: "/tmp/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.tar.gz"
        dest: "/tmp"
        remote_src: yes
        creates: "/tmp/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.linux-amd64/node_exporter"

    - name: Copy node_exporter binary to installation directory
      copy:
        src: "/tmp/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.linux-amd64/node_exporter"
        dest: "{{ node_exporter_install_dir }}/node_exporter"
        mode: '0755'
        owner: "{{ node_exporter_user }}"
        group: "{{ node_exporter_group }}"
        remote_src: yes

    - name: Create systemd service file
      template:
        src: node_exporter.service.j2
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/node_exporter.service
        mode: '0644'
      vars:
        install_dir: "{{ node_exporter_install_dir }}"
        user: "{{ node_exporter_user }}"
        group: "{{ node_exporter_group }}"
        listen_address: "{{ node_exporter_listen_address }}"
      notify:
        - Reload systemd
        - Restart node_exporter

    - name: Enable and start node_exporter service
      systemd:
        name: node_exporter
        enabled: yes
        state: started
        daemon_reload: yes

  handlers:
    - name: Reload systemd
      systemd:
        daemon_reload: yes

    - name: Restart node_exporter
      systemd:
        name: node_exporter
        state: restarted
